references.text: Repeats the same miracle that clothes did not wear out and feet did not swell during the forty years in the wilderness.
Nehemiah reminds the people of God's care in the wilderness, where their clothes did not wear out and their feet did not swell for forty years.
Describes the forty years the Israelites ate manna in the wilderness, which is the same period mentioned in Deuteronomy 8:4.
Explains why Israel wandered in the wilderness for forty years, the same time period mentioned in connection with God's miraculous care.
Stephen refers to the forty years in the wilderness when he tells the story of Israel's history.
Paul mentions that God put up with the people for forty years in the wilderness and points to God's faithful care.
